First, the important part

I'm sorry, Kuchupuchu.

I know you feel that I ignored you. And honestly, knowing that I made you feel that way hurts me. You deserve attention, care and the feeling that you matter — because you do matter to me.

I don't want one bad moment to become bigger than all the beautiful moments we've made together. So here's my very simple message: I'm really sorry. I love you. ❤️😘
